keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Words or phrases to search in the full notice text, in any EU language. A notice matches if it contains any of them. Leave empty to get everything that matches the other filters.

countries.title: Buyer countries
countries.description: Countries of the buying organisation, as 2-letter (DK) or 3-letter (DNK) codes. Leave empty for all of Europe.

cpvCodes.title: CPV codes
cpvCodes.description: Common Procurement Vocabulary codes. Short codes match whole families, for example 72 = IT services, 45 = construction work, 90910000 = cleaning services, 33 = medical equipment.

noticeTypes.title: Notice types
noticeTypes.description: Open calls are tenders you can still bid on. Prior information notices announce upcoming tenders. Awards show who won past tenders (useful for competitor research).

publishedWithinDays.title: Published within the last N days
publishedWithinDays.description: Only notices published in this many days, including today. TED publishes on weekdays.

onlyOpenDeadline.title: Only tenders still open for bids
onlyOpenDeadline.description: For open calls, skip notices whose submission deadline has already passed.

minEstimatedValue.title: Minimum estimated value
minEstimatedValue.description: Skip tenders with a smaller estimated value (in the notice's own currency). Many notices do not state a value; those are skipped when this is set.

preferredLanguages.title: Preferred text languages
preferredLanguages.description: Language codes for titles and descriptions, in order of preference (en, da, de, fr, sv, ...). Falls back to English, then to whatever language the buyer used.

onlyNewSinceLastRun.title: Only new notices since the last run (monitoring)
onlyNewSinceLastRun.description: Remember which notices were already delivered and return only new ones. Use with a schedule to get a daily tender alert. You are only charged for new notices.

monitorName.title: Monitor name
monitorName.description: Keeps separate memories for different saved searches when monitoring is on.
